user_query: What limitation of DeepWalk is reported in the visualization of the co-author network, especially for high-degree vertices?
llm_response: The visualization reports that DeepWalk tends to place high-degree vertices too close together, so it does not clearly separate or distinguish them in the co-author network. In other words, it has difficulty preserving the structure around hubs and can make the layout look overly crowded near high-degree nodes.
llm_confidence_reasoning: This is a well-known limitation of DeepWalk-based embeddings in network visualizations, but the exact wording can vary by source, so I am highly but not completely certain.
